chapter_title: Concerning the living Fire: It is present in Eight
spiritual_reading:
# The Eight
 Dwelling-Places of Holy
 Living Love

**
¶2:**
 The first dwelling
-
place of love is the ground of wisdom
 itself
,
 where
 love
 is
 present
 and subs
ists. It is established beneath that
 ground
,
 utterly beyond all
 derivative states. It is the fundamental
 principle
 and
 basis of the
 whole natural mind,
 and the deep
est interior perception
 that lies
 beneath all other states of
 thought
 and
 will
.

**¶3:** The
 second dwelling-place of love is the
 Divine Itself, the God of truth
 —
 for
 the Divine Itself is established in its
 own great and mighty interior perception. Love
 dwells first and
 foremost in the Divine. All
 the other faculties that proceeded from the
 Divine were made
 manifest through it, and love too came
 forth with them and was revealed
 through them.

**¶4
:** The third dwelling-place of love
 is the celestial human —
 the primordial spiritual will cloth
ed in protective truths. This love
 rests upon the whole external form of
 the perfected human.

**
¶5:** The fourth is
 that love which has been purified from
 all the faculties of wisdom,
 which resides in the outermost
 boundary of spiritual
 defense
, within
 the doctrine that
 carries
 the
 soul
 through
 states
 of enlightenment.


**¶6:** The fifth
 is that love which dwells within the
 doctrine that
 illumin
es
 obsc
ure states, within truth itself.


**¶7:** The sixth is
 that love purified from the whole.
 The Divine Proceeding cloth
ed it upon its own
 external form, over the calling-
forth and the reception. By means
 of this love many things were established.
 It descended and divested itself of that
 love before the Guardian of the threshold between
 interior
 and
 exterior states.

**¶8
:** The seventh is that living love which
 belongs to the regenerated natural mind,
 and is itself
 the interior perception. For it is the
 first found
ational principle
 of
 the regenerated mind;
 upon
 it they
 built anew the
 first course of
 spiritual
 life
, which is a
 governing
 wisdom over the entire natural mind. These
 foundations
 lie
 beneath all
 derivative
 states, set
 over the entire ground of falsity,
 containing
 it
.


**¶9:** The eighth
 is that love which shall be revealed within
 the human person, and it signifies
 the awe and spiritual combat of va
station. It
 displays and makes manifest its evidence in terrible
 power. It shall be revealed through
 both
 doctrines —
 of
 good
 and of
 truth —
 by
 which
 wisdom
 is carried
 through
 the world
.

**¶10:** This
 is the manner in which holy living love
 exists in these eight dwelling-places.


---


*
Note on
 method
:
* "
Fire
" throughout
 this
 chapter
 corresponds
 to **
love** —
 not
 as
 metaph
or but
 as spiritual
 substance
. The text maps
 love
's
 progressive
 dwelling
-
places from
 the deep
est divine
 interior out
ward through
 successive
 degrees
 of manifest
ation:
 the
 Divine Itself, the celestial will
, pur
ified doctrine
, truth
 in
 obsc
urity, the
 proce
eding divine
 activity
, the regener
ated natural mind, and finally the love
 that breaks
 forth
 in va
station and
 spiritual
 combat within
 the unre
generate
 person
. The "
two
 light ships" (
¶9) resist
 full
 translation —
 I
 have
 read
 them as the
 twin
 doctrines of good
 and truth, but
 they
 may
 correspond
 more
 precisely
 to the two
 vessels
 of love and wisdom by
 which all
 spiritual life
 is carried through natural
 states.

The third [place wherein it is], is the First Man, h[e] wh[o clothed himself in the] armour. Again, it is this fire [that was set and spread] on the body of the Perfect Man.
[The fourth is this fir]e that was purified from all the [light] powers, [which is i]n the outer wall, in the ship of the day.
